tasks.title: Create minimal public monorepo topology and governance
Implement strict core service, schemas, state, signing, and protocol application
Implement scoped Effect Platform Bun host and CLI runtime
Run repository, export, documentation, and packed-artifact verification
Consume packed unteam artifacts from Pollsor through a reviewed adapter seam
Create and read back public GitHub repository after local verification
Support the Pollsor full-system server adapter without importing consumer state
Provide the standalone JSON scenario and versioned readiness process contract
acceptance: Upgrade the exact Effect package family to beta.107 and use only APIs proven by the installed sources.

Require `--scenario <json-file-path>` and decode JSON with `effect/unstable/cli` plus the canonical `ServerScenarioV1` before listener acquisition; reject malformed, unknown-version, excess-property, missing-file, and invalid scenario input.
Run one `Effect.scoped` CLI program with `BunRuntime.runMain`, with no manual signal listeners, nested `Effect.runPromise`, raw Bun file access, or raw JSON parsing.

Schema-encode exactly one bounded `unteam.ready.v1` stdout line after scenario-ready listener acquisition; send bounded safe diagnostics to stderr and expose no secret, token, private key, path, or raw environment value.
Prove help and invalid startup, live readiness, HTTP snapshot, SIGTERM interruption, exact listener closure, secret-negative output, and a second fresh process with empty state.
